problem: A merged commercial pricing composer could be present in source control while the public pricing route still served the legacy Control/Scale surface.
root_cause: The canonical pricing source and production proof still treated the legacy pricing structure as authority, allowing later build stages and old production assertions to preserve the wrong surface.
decision: Make the SaaS plus consulting design canonical in prijzen.html, protect it through pricing-build-integrity, and require the same commercial tokens in production source snapshot and browser readback.
prevention: Commercial pricing must be canonical before build transforms.
Production proof must assert Starter, Pro, Groei, Enterprise and consulting/workshop content.
Legacy Control/Scale pricing markers cannot be the production success oracle.
